html_source: One of 57 photographs taken by H. McCrae during the summer of 1941 to document the destruction caused by German aerial bombardment on May 31, held in the North Strand Bombing Photographic Collection of the Dublin City Library and Archive. Source: northstrandbombing.ie.

One of 57 photographs taken by H. McCrae during
  the summer of 1941 to document the destruction caused by German
  aerial bombardment on May 31, held in the North Strand Bombing
  Photographic Collection of the Dublin City Library and Archive.
  Source: northstrandbombing.ie.
